azureLogAnalytics.query:
StorageBlobLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize
    Total   = count(),
    Success = countif(StatusCode startswith "2"),
    Failed  = countif(StatusCode !startswith "2")
    by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

StorageBlobLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize count() by OperationName
| sort by count_ desc
| render piechart

StorageBlobLogs
| summarize Calls = count() by CallerIpAddress
| top 20 by Calls desc

StorageBlobLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize lastWrite = max(TimeGenerated) by AccountName
| extend freshnessHours = datetime_diff("hour", now(), lastWrite)
| order by freshnessHours asc

StorageBlobLogs
| summarize operations = count() by AccountName
| top 5 by operations desc

StorageBlobLogs
| where toint(StatusCode) >= 400
| summarize Count = count()
  by StatusCode
| order by Count desc

StorageBlobLogs
| summarize Count = count() by OperationName
| order by  Count desc

StorageBlobLogs
| extend StatusCodeInt = toint(StatusCode)
| where StatusCodeInt >= 400
| summarize Count = count() by StatusText
| order by Count desc
